title: Smoky Vegan Skewers
description: Grilled skewers with a smoky flavor, perfect for a summer evening. This dish is free from animal products and can be enjoyed by vegans.

ingredients.name: yummy
ingredients.notes: your favorite vegetables, such as bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Cut the tofu into cubes and place them in a bowl.
Add the yummy vegetables and the smoky seasoning to the bowl and mix well.
Thread the tofu and vegetable mixture onto the skewers.
Brush the skewers with a little oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they are golden brown and cooked through.
